_note: case-last-activity-at: when someone last worked on the case (a status move, a note, a document or contact created on it, a completed task). CaseLastActivityListener stamps it; a save that leaves the status alone does not, unlike @self.updated, which the nightly rematerialisation and an example-set refresh move on every case. daysSinceActivity (base file) counts from it and the stalled lists sort on it. case 1.58.0.

lastActivityAt.title: Last activity at
lastActivityAt.description: When someone last worked on the case: a status move, a note, a document or a contact created on it, or a task completed. A save that changes none of these leaves it.
